_what_this_is: What the algorithms learned about the substrate they run on. Written by any algorithm, read by all of them. algorithms.json says what each algorithm IS; this says what each one LEARNED.
_the_rule: every memory carries who learned it, from what evidence, and what other algorithms should do differently because of it. A memory with no implication is a note, and notes are not machine-actionable.

_kinds.INSTRUMENT: a log, table or channel and how far it can actually see
_kinds.SUBSTRATE: how the system behaves under load — timeouts, drops, limits
_kinds.CARRIER: a column or object that does or does not carry what it claims
_kinds.TRAP: a way of reading the data that produces a confident wrong answer

memories.subject: cdhdr
memories.fact: the change-document header extract is a FILTERED SUBSET. It carries 57 object classes; cdhdr_history carries 72. Missing from cdhdr: PBC, SETS, SUSR_PROF and every custom Y* class.
memories.evidence: 57 vs 72 distinct OBJECTCLAS; PBC's 3.4M changes absent from cdhdr entirely
memories.implication: NEVER answer 'who changed this' from cdhdr alone. Read cdhdr_history too and reconcile. An object absent from cdhdr has not necessarily stopped changing — it may simply not be in this extract.

memories.subject: cdhdr_history
memories.fact: the fuller change log: 72 object classes, 2024-01-01 to 2026-06-20, and the ONLY store carrying PBC, SETS (hierarchy maintenance), SUSR_PROF (authorisation profiles) and the custom Y* change-document objects.
memories.evidence: 12,029,963 rows; classes present here and absent from cdhdr: 15
memories.implication: this is the default change instrument, not the fallback. Hierarchy and authorisation questions can ONLY be answered here.

memories.subject: P01.rfc_session
memories.fact: the connection degrades and drops after roughly a dozen calls, and a wide read hangs
memories.evidence: observed across the log accumulator and the P01 source extractor
memories.implication: chunk every temporal read to <=6h windows and reconnect on COMMUNICATION_FAILURE / 'partner not reached' rather than treating it as a real answer. A silently truncated window looks like a quiet period.

memories.subject: _query_shape
memories.fact: resolving row-by-row in Python what could be aggregated in SQL first is the single most expensive mistake available here — measured at 548x on one rewrite
memories.evidence: A8 runtime >1h -> 3m29s after pre-aggregating 15.6M audit rows into 987K slots
memories.implication: aggregate with GROUP BY, then resolve the small result. A correlated subquery over a multi-million-row fact table is not a query, it is a scan per row.

memories.subject: fmifiit_full.MEASURE
memories.fact: Funded Program — SAP's designed WBS-to-FM bridge — is declared and blank in every row. So are FAREA, GRANT_NBR and PRCTR. The FM ledger posts on exactly two legs: Fund x Fund Center.
memories.evidence: 0 populated of 2,308,814 rows for MEASURE, FAREA, GRANT_NBR, PRCTR
memories.implication: no query may join FM actuals to work through MEASURE. Any analysis that needs 'which project consumed this' must reconstruct it by identifier grammar, and must say so.

memories.subject: prps.POSID
memories.fact: the WBS identifier CARRIES the chain the schema does not: its root before the first dot is the fund code, and its dot depth is its hierarchy level. 99.5% of WBS elements resolve to a real fund this way.
memories.evidence: 59,424 of 59,749 roots match funds.FINCODE; depth runs 1..7
memories.implication: the fund-to-work link is reconstructable without Funded Program. Use root(POSID). And note depth >4 exists (2,046 elements), so any code assuming the designed 4-level spine will mis-handle them.

memories.subject: funds.FINCODE
memories.fact: three code grammars coexist in one field and the grammar predicts the fund TYPE family: all-numeric (73%) = RP/staff types 0xx, NNN+GEO+NNNN (21%) = extrabudgetary delivery types 1xx, and legacy alpha-prefixed variants.
memories.evidence: 56,752 UNES funds over 30 shapes; TYPE concentration >=50% within the top shapes
memories.implication: the identifier is a classification, not a label. Any filter, grouping or sample that ignores the grammar mixes populations that have nothing to do with each other.

memories.subject: FMFINCODE
memories.fact: the fund-master change-document class carries ZERO records in either change log, while the fund master holds 67,526 funds
memories.evidence: 0 rows for OBJECTCLAS='FMFINCODE' in cdhdr and cdhdr_history
memories.implication: who creates and changes funds cannot be answered from the change log at all. Fall back to A8 attribution against the execution log — it is the only instrument left for the most heavily populated master in the model.

memories.subject: YFMFUNDC5
memories.fact: a CUSTOM change-document object exists for the custom fund-to-C/5 bridge table, and it appears only in cdhdr_history
memories.evidence: 2,221 records, cdhdr_history only
memories.implication: custom carriers can have custom instruments. Discover change-document classes by name affinity against the table rather than assuming the standard SAP list is complete.

memories.subject: fmavct.RCMMTITEM
memories.fact: the availability-control object collapses the commitment-item leg: at 63.7% of Fund x Fund Center addresses, several distinct commitment items arrive at a single grouped bucket
memories.evidence: 5,949 addresses compared; 3.99 FIPEX in vs 1.48 RCMMTITEM out
memories.implication: availability is checked on a SHARED pool. Never report 'this cost category had budget' from AVC — the bucket is shared, so consumption by one category silently reduces headroom for its neighbours.

memories.subject: prps -> funds
memories.fact: this link resolves at 99.5% through STRING PREFIX of POSID, NOT through the designed FMMEASURE / Funded Program derivation via FMDERIVE
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: proj -> funds
memories.fact: this link resolves at 98.8% through STRING IDENTITY (PSPID = FINCODE), NOT through the designed none — Fund and Project are meant to be independent dimensions
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: prps -> proj
memories.fact: this link resolves at 99.8% through same, plus the string root agrees, NOT through the designed PRPS.PSPHI -> PROJ.PSPNR (the real SAP foreign key)
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: cdhdr.FMRESERV
memories.fact: a ratio of months-with-a-change to months-of-life MEASURES THE LIFETIME, not the behaviour: any document created and closed inside one month scores 1.00 by construction, and 34.7% of reservation documents live exactly one month
memories.evidence: median ratio 0.96 over all documents vs 0.32 once lives under 6 months are excluded
memories.implication: whenever a rate is built as events-per-window, exclude the entities whose window is one unit long before reading the median. Otherwise the metric confirms whatever the short-lived population happens to look like

memories.subject: FMDERIVE
memories.fact: the derivation tool holds NO strategy here and FMDERIVE is not a registered derivation point; FM account assignment runs on the CLASSIC TABADR* mechanism with 3,627 rule rows
memories.evidence: T811C/S/K empty; T811X registers CCSS, CEST7, GLPCT, JBDST7 only; TABADRSF 3,627
memories.implication: never explain an empty Funded Program as neglect. The architecture in use cannot fill it, so any proposal to use that dimension is a proposal to stand up a second derivation mechanism

memories.subject: RFC_READ_TABLE
memories.fact: the work area is 512 characters, so a table wider than that needs several reads — and they must be merged ON THE KEY, never on row position
memories.evidence: FMIT is 861 wide over 66 fields; three key-merged chunks agreed at 770,774 rows
memories.implication: repeat the key columns in every chunk. Position merging looks identical and silently scrambles fields onto the wrong rows when the two reads come back in different orders

memories.subject: SETCLASS 0312
memories.fact: FUND CENTRES — the organisational / responsibility axis — 175 sets, 15 roots, max depth 3, 454 values reached; 263 orphans, 0 multi-parent values
memories.evidence: {"orphan_pct": 36.7, "multi_parent_within_one_tree": 0, "values_in_several_root_trees": 272, "max_depth": 3}
memories.implication: never sum levels of this hierarchy — a parent already contains its children, and 0.0% of fact rows would double count. 20.6% of rows sit on values no node contains.

memories.evidence: {"orphan_pct": null, "multi_parent_within_one_tree": 3, "values_in_several_root_trees": 134184, "max_depth": 5}
memories.implication: never sum levels of this hierarchy — a parent already contains its children, and 0.0% of fact rows would double count. 0.0% of rows sit on values no node contains.

memories.subject: fund_centers hierarchy coverage
memories.fact: an orphan COUNT and an orphan VOLUME describe different things: 263 of 717 fund centres are outside the hierarchy, and 240 of those never post — three centres carry 98.1% of the orphan volume
memories.evidence: UNESCO 331,526 / CSI 89,846 / MBF 44,488 of 474,874 orphan lines
memories.implication: always weight a coverage gap by the fact volume before calling it a gap. A third of a master missing sounds like decay; the same measurement weighted by postings is three named objects, each needing a different answer

memories.subject: fund_centers_text
memories.fact: a fund-centre acronym can be REUSED for a different subject decades later without the descriptive text being updated — CSI is texted 'Coastal Regions Small Islands' (2002) and carries the Capital and Strategic Investments special account (2021)
memories.evidence: 89,808 of 89,846 lines on fund 643CSI9000 'SA for Capital and Strategic Investments'
memories.implication: never take a master-data description as the meaning of a code. Confirm against what the code actually carries — the funds, the commitment items, the business transaction. A report printing the name is right about the number and wrong about the subject

memories.subject: YCL_FI_BR_UPDATE_TABLES
memories.fact: a class full of UPDATE and INSERT methods proves a WRITE PATH EXISTS, not that it is used. YTFM_BR_FMIOI and YTFM_BR_FM_POS are its targets and both hold zero rows
memories.evidence: YTFM_BR_FMIOI 0 rows, YTFM_BR_FM_POS 0 rows after extraction
memories.implication: before describing a mechanism from its writer, count the rows in what it writes to. A writer with empty targets is a path that was built and abandoned, which is a different finding from the one the code suggests

memories.subject: fund centre roll-up
memories.fact: no organisational hierarchy is built: FMHICTR is empty while FMHICI and FMHIVARNT carry data. Every maintained structure groups WHAT is spent
memories.evidence: FMHICTR 0 rows; FMHICI and FMHIVARNT return rows; custom set readers use class 0102
memories.implication: do not report fund-centre coverage gaps as reporting defects. There is no organisational total to distort. Check whether a hierarchy is BUILT before scoring what falls outside it

memories.subject: custom fields
memories.fact: 168 custom (owner, field) pairs harvested from source; states {'NOT_A_TABLE': 110, 'TABLE_NOT_EXTRACTED': 36, 'POPULATED': 22}
memories.evidence: C:/Users/jp_lopez/projects/abapobjectscreation/brain_v2/custom_fields.json
memories.implication: before designing anything that needs a new field, check this inventory — the slot may already exist, typed and upgrade-proof. And never read a NOT_EXTRACTED state as empty

memories.subject: duplicated dimensions
memories.fact: when a dimension is added a second time here, the first one is NOT retired — both stay live and nothing declares which is authoritative. Measured three times: budget-rate fund scope, the organisational hierarchy, and the fund-to-C/5 output link
memories.evidence: fund-to-output: native ZZOUTPUT 8,615 vs bridge ytfm_fund_c5 14,047, overlap 8,518
memories.implication: before using any dimension, check whether a second carrier of the same fact exists and measure the disagreement. Reading one and reporting it as the answer is how two correct systems produce two different numbers

memories.subject: YTFM_BR_FMIFIIT
memories.fact: the record of BR-affected postings: 12,852 rows, all UNES/EUR/ledger 9A, covering 99.8% of the derived perimeter in 2025 and ZERO rows in 2024
memories.evidence: perimeter 2025 10,400 vs 10,383 recorded; 2024 perimeter 10,660 vs 0 recorded
memories.implication: this is the population to measure the budget rate on. And do not assume 2024 behaves like 2025 — the mechanism's first declared year has no record at all

memories.subject: budget rate
memories.fact: the fixed rate is 1.0416667 (= 1/0.96) and it is NOT present in the FM actual lines: inside the perimeter it appears on 0.1-0.2% of lines against 2.59% outside it
memories.evidence: ZFKBTR/ZTRBTR constant at 1.0416667 across 12,396 matched control rows
memories.implication: never answer a budget-rate question from FKBTR/TRBTR in fmifiit_full. And when testing whether a rate is applied, always measure an out-of-perimeter control group — here it turned a 0.1% hit rate from 'rare' into 'coincidence'

memories.subject: EURX
memories.fact: the budget rate is exchange rate TYPE EURX, not M. 60 entries over 55 currency pairs; USD/EUR is 1.09529 from 2024-01-01. It is applied in the FM ledger only and FI/GL keeps the standard rate
memories.evidence: perimeter lines at EURX 94.7% (2025) vs 0.09% outside the perimeter
memories.implication: any budget-rate question starts by reading TCURR for KURST='EURX'. And never label a rate 'the market' without checking which rate type produced it — that error turned a positive finding into a published negative one

memories.subject: _negative_results
memories.fact: a control group makes a negative result look rigorous and cannot save a test that searches for the wrong value. The fixed rate was searched for at 1.0416667, taken from an unused control table, while the mechanism applies 1.09529
memories.evidence: claim 438 concluded absence with a 0.1%-vs-2.59% control; the real figure was 94.7% vs 0.09%
memories.implication: before concluding something is ABSENT, derive what it would look like from the CONFIGURATION — one query to the rate-type table here — rather than from a derived artefact

memories.subject: CHECK_CONDITIONS
memories.fact: every condition is guarded by IF IV_xxx IS NOT INITIAL, so a parameter passed EMPTY skips its check. The effective perimeter is set by the caller, not by the class
memories.evidence: extracted_sap_p01/YA/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL.abap lines 131-161: eight CHECKs, each inside an IS NOT INITIAL guard
memories.implication: never reproduce such a perimeter as a WHERE clause and call it the perimeter. Read the CALL SITES to learn which conditions are actually in force, and state any data-side approximation as the superset it is

memories.subject: _joins
memories.fact: two wrong joins in one analysis, both producing confident totals: omitting the COMPANY CODE from a document key let numbers collide across company codes, and comparing signed FM amounts to unsigned BSEG amounts produced a 152-million 'impact' that was pure sign error
memories.evidence: the first matched 4,000 USD against 1,875; the second gave -152,643,650 vs the real -1,223,731
memories.implication: before reporting any joined total, print six matched pairs side by side and read them. Both errors were obvious at the row level and invisible at the total level

memories.subject: YFM_FI_COMPARE_INCLUDING_BR
memories.fact: the organisation's own FM-vs-FI control, with FINAL_DIFF = FKBTR - DMBTR - ZZAMOUNTBRDIFF. The budget-rate part is netted out and the residual is the real break. The standard baseline has FOUR routes by value type and the fallback is rate type M, which the code calls UNORE
memories.evidence: report + YCL_FM_FI_COMPARE_BL line 709 + GET_BR_IMPACT lines 432-500
memories.implication: when an organisation already has a control for a question, read it before reconstructing the definition from data. This one supplied four baselines where we had assumed one

memories.subject: budget rate impact
memories.fact: impact -4178499.57 USD over 15542 lines, replicating the organisation's own four baselines
memories.evidence: brain_v2/br_impact.json
memories.implication: route 1 covers most LINES and route 4 covers most MONEY — never quote an impact computed from one route alone

memories.subject: FMIOI
memories.fact: the COMMITMENT table. Value types 50 and 51 exist here and NOT in fmifiit_full. The golden held it as 13 of its 69 columns until s098, without VRGNG, BTART or TWAER
memories.evidence: re-pulled: 2,254,039 rows over 69 columns; route 2 has 191,181 lines here and 0 in the actuals
memories.implication: a value type absent from the actuals table is not absent from the system — look in the commitments. And check the COLUMN COUNT of a golden table before concluding a field's population

memories.subject: _sliced_loads
memories.fact: a partition load that fails AFTER its INSERT commits will double the partition on retry, and the result looks like a clean load
memories.evidence: FMIOI 2026 held 1,031,772 rows where 515,894 belonged — exactly 2.0x
memories.implication: a sliced load must DELETE the slice before inserting it. And verify a load by DISTINCT KEY count, not by row count

memories.subject: ENHO source
memories.fact: an enhancement implementation IS readable: its source lives in a generated include named <ENHNAME> padded to 30 characters with '=' then 'E'. ENHOBJ gives the hooked object, ENHINCINX gives the include
memories.evidence: all 12 ZFIX enhancements read from P01, 1,154 lines, after padding to 30 not 31
memories.implication: never record an object type as unreadable without constructing its generated name first. This one stood open as a blocker for a whole analysis because the padding was one character wrong

memories.subject: CHECK_CONDITIONS call sites
memories.fact: the perimeter varies BY MOMENT. Revaluation passes only the fund type, so it carries no currency, business-area, commitment-item or transaction restriction
memories.evidence: ZFIX_BR_REVALUATION and ZFIX_BR_REVAL_RESFUND pass IV_FTYPE alone
memories.implication: never state 'the perimeter' of a mechanism from the class that defines it. Read the CALL SITES — here they give twelve different perimeters from one class

memories.subject: _rate_matching
memories.fact: matching a fixed rate is NOT proof that a conversion happened, because the moving baseline can take that value on its own. EURX is the operational rate frozen at the biennium, so the two coincide at the start
memories.evidence: 2024 route-1 impact exactly 0.00 over 465 pairs; operational rate = 1.09529 on 2024-01-15 and 2024-08-15
memories.implication: an impact of EXACTLY zero is not a small effect — it is the signature of NO effect. Treat a rate match as evidence only in periods where the fixed and moving rates differ

memories.subject: commitments
memories.fact: a budget-rate impact cannot be computed on COMMITMENTS. SAP calculates and recalculates them through its own logic, so there is no stable counterpart amount to difference against. Only FINANCIAL POSTINGS have an FI counterpart
memories.evidence: the organisation's own control differences FKBTR against DMBTR, which exists only for actual line items
memories.implication: measure impact on fmifiit_full and its FI counterparts only. On the commitment side you can establish PRESENCE — the rate does apply, at six of the twelve moments — but never a difference

memories.subject: WWERT
memories.fact: SAP converts on the TRANSLATION DATE (bkpf-WWERT) when it is set, not on the posting date. The golden's bkpf held 18 of 122 columns and did not carry it
memories.evidence: 416 of 422 2024 pairs match the operational rate on WWERT; on BUDAT they did not
memories.implication: never derive a document's exchange rate from BUDAT. Use WWERT when present, then KURSF when the document carries its own rate

memories.subject: YYCDR
memories.fact: the personnel budget-rate perimeter is an HR FEATURE, YYCDR, evaluated per employee per date against PA0001 — not a set of ranges
memories.evidence: YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL::CHECK_CONDITIONS calls CL_HRPA_FEATURE=>GET_VALUE
memories.implication: a perimeter can live in a decision tree maintained in PE03, invisible to any code or table search. When a gate looks absent from the source, look for a feature

memories.subject: _disabled_code
memories.fact: IF 1 = 2 is a live switch: the two-step personnel conversion is fully implemented and unreachable, and reading the class alone would report it as the mechanism
memories.evidence: ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_PBC_POS_UPD lines 42-54 wrap both CONVERT_TO_BUDGET_RATE calls
memories.implication: never describe a method as the mechanism without checking that its call sites are reachable. Grep the call site for IF 1 = 2, CHECK abap_false and commented blocks before believing the class

memories.subject: budget rate graph
memories.fact: 33 subjects related by 42 typed edges; 38 claims on the subject
memories.evidence: brain_v2/budget_rate_graph.json
memories.implication: ask the graph before re-deriving: the relation between perimeter, moments, rate type and control is recorded, not remembered

memories.subject: HR features
memories.fact: every HR feature is COMPILED into a generated program named /1PAPA/FEAT<client><NAME>, and that program is readable through RPY_PROGRAM_READ. T549D gives the name and the structure
memories.evidence: YYCDR -> /1PAPA/FEAT350YYCDR, 118 lines of nested CASE; T549B held nothing
memories.implication: a decision tree maintained in PE03 is NOT invisible. When a gate cannot be found in code or tables, look for a feature and read its compiled program

memories.subject: _empty_tables
memories.fact: an empty trace table has THREE explanations, not two: not reached, not landing, or ran once and stopped. The personnel budget rate is the third — six runs in January 2025 and nothing after
memories.evidence: YTFM_BR_PAYPH 12 rows all January 2025; YTFM_BR_FM_POS 0 rows behind IF 1 = 2
memories.implication: check the DATE RANGE of a sparse table before concluding anything about a mechanism. A table with 703 rows and a table with 0 rows can belong to the same mechanism in different states

memories.subject: _built_but_never_applied
memories.fact: a mechanism can be complete in every visible respect — classes, tables, an HR feature, a driver program, a transaction, a control report — and never have been put into production. The personnel budget rate is exactly that
memories.evidence: driver YFM_BR_POSTING_IN_FM has 0 executions in a 4-month audit window while the control report has 43; the only data is a 6-run pilot in January 2025
memories.implication: existence in the repository is not evidence of operation. Check the EXECUTION LOG for the driver before describing any mechanism as running — and note that a control report being used regularly says nothing about whether the controlled process runs

memories.subject: BR for Staff
memories.fact: the staff budget rate is computed in the PAYROLL ENGINE and carried by 72 'Constant Dollar' wage types in country grouping UN, each mirroring a base wage type at the fixed rate
memories.evidence: T512T MOLGA 'UN': 99 wage types in the 9xxx range, 72 named 'Constant Dollar for <base>'
memories.implication: a payroll mechanism may be named after its OUTPUT and nowhere else. Searching schemas and rule content for the concept found nothing; the wage-type catalogue found it immediately

memories.subject: payroll calculation layer
memories.fact: schemas (T52C0/T52C1), rules (T52C5), wage types (T512T) and features (T549D) are ALL readable from P01 over RFC. 68,767 schema steps, 166,453 rule lines, 60,078 wage types, 2,888 features
memories.evidence: all four read this session while tracing BR for Staff; none was in the golden
memories.implication: payroll logic is not a black box. When a calculation cannot be found in ABAP, it is probably in the payroll engine — and the engine is configuration, which reads like data

memories.subject: payroll end to end
memories.fact: 67 schemas (45 custom), 11742 rules (307 custom), 1641 wage types, 2888 features (19 custom)
memories.evidence: brain_v2/payroll_discovery.json
memories.implication: the payroll engine is configuration and reads like data. Run this before assuming any staff-cost calculation is unreachable

memories.subject: payroll posting path
memories.fact: all eleven enhancements on the payroll posting path are CUSTOM, four of them on RPCIPE00_OLD for accounts payable and retro
memories.evidence: ENHOBJ on RPCIPE00/RPCIPE00_OLD/HRBEN00PAYROLL and the HR infotype UI
memories.implication: the seam between payroll and accounting is where this installation intervened. Read those four before describing how staff cost reaches FI

memories.subject: _channel_difference
memories.fact: the same object reached through DIFFERENT transactions by different users is a governance signal. SE38 for NRINTERVAL by one user while everyone else uses AS08/OBH2/BUCF/FBN1/SNUM; SE38 for IDENTITY running a program that has its own transaction
memories.evidence: A_SEFIANI 25 NRINTERVAL via SE38, sole user; P.IKOUNA 3,626 IDENTITY via SE38
memories.implication: the population of maintainers defines the norm — no policy document needed. A route that differs from the modal route for the same object is what makes an action invisible to the controls built around the transaction

memories.subject: transported table content
memories.fact: transported TABU objects rose from 19 in August 2025 to 239 in November on an unchanged transport cadence, and they are mostly the generated authorisation layer — AGR_TIMEB, USR10, USR11, UST12
memories.evidence: cts_objects joined to cts_transports by month since 2024
memories.implication: count transported CONTENT separately from transported DEVELOPMENT. The transport count alone is flat and hides a tenfold rise in data movement

memories.subject: change governance
memories.fact: 9 channel differences, 20 objects changed in production and never transported
memories.evidence: brain_v2/change_governance.json
memories.implication: the maintainer population is the norm. Run this before asking anyone for a policy — and read every finding with its counter-explanation

memories.subject: _generic_route_as_norm
memories.fact: a detector looking for the SOLE USER of an unusual route misses the worse case: the generic route being the MODAL one. NRINTERVAL has 18 maintainers and SE38 is the most-used path
memories.evidence: A_SEFIANI's 25 NRINTERVAL changes via SE38 are the largest single route for that object
memories.implication: check whether the modal route is itself generic before looking for outliers. An object whose normal maintenance path is the editor has no working maintenance route at all

memories.subject: _persistence
memories.fact: a table read live and not persisted costs the answer twice: T52EL was reported EMPTY for MOLGA 'UN' from a malformed live query, and once loaded the same question took one query and gave 72 hits
memories.evidence: T52EL 6,735 rows over 32 country groupings; all 72 Constant Dollar wage types configured
memories.implication: persist every table you read. Process mining is re-reading the base you already hold and finding new insight — a live read answers one question and leaves nothing behind

memories.subject: transported content
memories.fact: the tenfold rise in transported table data is holiday calendars and HR form scenarios, not master-data intervention. The transport TEXT reversed the reading the volume trend suggested
memories.evidence: 137 calendar objects in 12 transports; 492 form-scenario objects; E07T supplied the texts
memories.implication: read the text before reading the trend. A trend measured on volume alone invites a conclusion the content refutes

memories.subject: staff budget rate posting
memories.fact: the staff budget rate posts as a SIGN-REVERSED TWIN: 58 of 58 configured pairs send the Constant Dollar wage type to the same symbolic account as its base with the opposite sign, so the two net on the account
memories.evidence: T52EL MOLGA UN: 0020 +SPAL / 9020 -SPAL, 0032 +BSAL / 9032 -BSAL, and 56 more
memories.implication: on the staff side the budget-rate difference is POSTED rather than computed by a report. To size it, resolve the payroll symbolic account to its GL account first — that link is not in T030, T030B or T52EZ

memories.subject: _field_width
memories.fact: a payroll symbolic account is CHAR(4) and T030-KTOSL is CHAR(3), so the FI account determination CANNOT hold it. Several queries against T030 and T030B were impossible by construction
memories.evidence: DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET on T030-KTOSL and T52EK-SYMKO
memories.implication: when a join returns nothing, compare the FIELD WIDTHS before extracting more tables. One call ended a line of enquiry that three extractions had not

memories.subject: T9POST
memories.fact: the payroll-to-FM bridge is a CUSTOM table in the customer range: symbolic account x employee grouping -> company code, business area, cost centre, position, FUND CENTRE and FUND. 2,673 rows over 133 symbolic accounts
memories.evidence: T9POST extracted from P01; the 24 Constant Dollar symbolic accounts appear in none
memories.implication: payroll reaches FM through a custom table, not through standard account determination. Look in the customer table range when a standard bridge does not exist

memories.subject: _read_the_documents_not_the_configuration
memories.fact: when the configuration will not yield an assignment, the POSTED DOCUMENTS carry the resolved result on one row. PPDIT holds the FI transaction key and the resolved GL account together
memories.evidence: 4,000 PPDIT items: 2 of 4 keys fan out to several accounts, 28 of 28 accounts belong to one key
memories.implication: read what happened rather than reconstructing what was configured. It does not depend on having found the right customising table, and the CARDINALITY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS identifies where the decision is really made

memories.subject: PPDIT
memories.fact: the payroll posting document items carry KTOSL — the CHAR(3) FI TRANSACTION KEY, not the CHAR(4) payroll symbolic account — alongside the resolved GL account
memories.evidence: PPDIT KTOSL values HRA, HRC, HRF, HRK against 28 HKONT values
memories.implication: do not read PPDIT-KTOSL as a symbolic account. Two different keys share that field name across HR and FI, and confusing them cost three extractions

memories.subject: _as_designed_is_not_as_run
memories.fact: I read T512T, T512W and T52EL, found 72 Constant Dollar wage types with 58 perfectly paired postings, and called it the mechanism. ZERO of them post. The difference is carried by one wage type, 999S
memories.evidence: PPOIX 2026: 297 distinct wage types post, none of the 72; 999S -> CUSD/CUS1/CUSA -> 999 GL accounts
memories.implication: a configuration table CANNOT report that its own contents are dormant. Before calling a configured mechanism THE mechanism, check it against the documents it is supposed to produce

memories.subject: 999S
memories.fact: the staff budget-rate difference is carried by a single wage type, 999S 'SUM DIF Exch. rate Fluct.', to symbolic accounts CUSD/CUS1/CUSA and GL accounts 999999x whose own names say 'Constant dollar'
memories.evidence: PPDIT 2026: the 999 block nets to exactly 0.00 per currency. AMOUNT CORRECTED s098 — USD 1,982,154.59 and EUR 796,418.86 on runs that actually posted. The first figure, USD 20,523,434.48, summed 1,828 of 2,316 runs that were SIMULATIONS (90% of the amount)
memories.implication: the impact is POSTED and self-balancing, not a residual between two valuations — which is why FI/GL and FM agree on the personnel side. Look for a named account before assuming a difference must be computed And read these tables through the golden view payroll_runs_posted: the simulations were purged, but a live P01 read would return them.

memories.subject: _summarised_posting
memories.fact: one PPDIT line is the SUM of several PPOIX rows — a document line of 46.80 was 10.96 + 35.84. Joining the two and summing the PPDIT amount double-counts
memories.evidence: ppdit x ppdix x ppoix, doc 0002768732/0000000001
memories.implication: aggregate on the side whose granularity you want. The arithmetic of the sample is also how you VERIFY the join is right — the parts summing to the whole is the proof the keys line up

memories.subject: _simulations_look_exactly_like_postings
memories.fact: 1,828 of 2,316 payroll posting runs in 2026 never reached FI. They carry the same document structure as real ones and nothing in the row says which is which. Summing without filtering overstated the impact NINEFOLD
memories.evidence: by run: 488 wholly in FI, 1,828 wholly absent, ZERO partial; USD 18.5M of 20.5M was simulation
memories.implication: before summing any operational table, ask what in it never actually happened. The discriminator is usually one table away — here, whether the run produced an accounting document at all

memories.subject: _uniform_ratio_is_a_missing_filter
memories.fact: the payroll-to-FI ratio was 11.5% and it was the SAME across every company code and document type. That uniformity was the tell: an incidental gap varies, a systematic filter does not
memories.implication: a suspiciously even ratio across unrelated groupings means a filter is missing from the query, not that the data is strange. Regroup by the process unit — here the RUN — and the structure appears

memories.subject: SUSP
memories.fact: SUSP is the payroll SUSPENSE symbolic account, and the custom ZZSUBST_KOMOK records moving a line off it onto a real account — 2,627 times in 2026, always from SUSP, on one to three employees a month
memories.evidence: ppoix 2026: source KOMOK is SUSP on 100% of the 2,627 substituted rows; KOART moves FZ -> CZ
memories.implication: a suspense account plus a custom correction field is a repair path for failed account determination. Its volume measures how often the determination fails, which is a quality metric nobody is reporting

memories.subject: _purge_beats_a_remembered_filter
memories.fact: simulation runs were DELETED from the golden rather than filtered by convention. 89% of the payroll detail went, and half of every unrelated measurement taken beforehand moved with it — the substitutions fell from 2,627 to 1,264
memories.evidence: purge_simulation_runs.py --apply; 21.0M detail rows -> 2.18M
memories.implication: when data contains records of things that never happened, make the wrong answer UNAVAILABLE instead of writing down a filter to remember. But keep the parent table that proves they existed, and never apply a discriminator outside the window where its evidence exists

memories.subject: ppdhd
memories.fact: only 3.7% of RUNID in ppdhd are evidenced in bkpf — the rest are recorded but never happened
memories.evidence: A18: 1364 wholly real, 35482 wholly absent, 0 partial
memories.implication: filter through the evidence table before summing anything from ppdhd

memories.subject: _the_golden_mixes_table_name_case
memories.fact: 165 of 374 objects in the golden are UPPERCASE (PPDHD, FMIOI, PPOIX, LFA1, REGUH) and the rest lowercase. An exact-match check against sqlite_master silently skips them
memories.evidence: A18's first run reported every probe as 'not in the golden'; zero case-collisions exist
memories.implication: match table names case-INSENSITIVELY. Duplicates are impossible — SQLite treats the names as identical for identity — so the hazard is a query that misses in silence, not a table that doubles

memories.subject: _never_real_vs_no_longer_live
memories.fact: a COMPLETED commitment is the most real kind of record — it completed because it became an actual. Counting it as unreal alongside simulations reported FMIOI at 95.6% when it is 2.1%, and would have invalidated a correct figure
memories.evidence: FMIOI: LOEKZ 46,952 never-real vs ERLKZ 2,153,034 no-longer-live; A14 route-2 27,453 lines, 552 without ERLKZ
memories.implication: before excluding rows, ask which sum you are protecting. NEVER_REAL invalidates WHAT HAPPENED; NO_LONGER_LIVE only invalidates WHAT IS OUTSTANDING. A filter that is too aggressive destroys good data as surely as no filter overstates

memories.subject: _an_algorithm_that_never_ran
memories.fact: A18 was written, registered and documented before it had ever executed. Its first run found two defects in itself and one in A16 — a live P01 read that would have undone the purge
memories.evidence: exact-match skip; never-real conflation; A16 Session.read bypassing the golden
memories.implication: an algorithm that has never run is a hypothesis, not a capability. Run it before registering its state as anything but NEW

memories.subject: PRPS.YYE_*
memories.fact: thirteen custom fields on the WBS element form ONE design — a programmatic and donor classification (strategy, programme, keywords, sub-donor, beneficiary, country type, coordinator, cooperating agency, point of contact) — built, upgrade-surviving, and filled on at most 0.61% of 60,292 WBS elements
memories.evidence: A18 dormant sweep: YYE_MAINST2 0, YYE_POC 367, YYE_COOP_AGENCY 323, the rest between
memories.implication: read custom fields as a GROUP before reading them one by one. Thirteen sparse fields look like thirteen abandoned ideas; together they are one coherent reporting layer waiting to be used

memories.subject: _dormancy_is_the_norm_here
memories.fact: five independent kinds of built-and-unused capacity, found five different ways: sparse custom columns, empty custom tables, configured entries that post nothing, a named mechanism whose 72 wage types never fire, and code behind IF 1 = 2
memories.evidence: brain_v2/dormant_capacity.json
memories.implication: do not treat an unused extension as an anomaly to explain. In this installation it is the normal state, so the useful question is not 'why is this empty' but 'what was it for and can the new design use it'

memories.subject: _the_empty_value_depends_on_the_type
memories.fact: a numeric or NUMC custom field is NEVER blank — it defaults to zero — so a trim(col)<>'' test counts '0.00' and '00000000' as values. Ten PRPS fields looked 100% filled; YYE_PRCTO is 0.45% real
memories.evidence: YYE_PRCTO 60,021 of 60,292 are '0.00'; YYE_RELEV 58,377 of 60,292 are '0'
memories.implication: strip the type's own null representation before judging emptiness: trim(trim(col),'0.'). One emptiness test for every type is how a dormant field passes as a live one

memories.subject: PRPS.YYE_DONOR
memories.fact: filled on 82% of WBS elements created in 2002 and 5% of those created in 2026, declining almost monotonically for 24 years. It WAS the practice and something displaced it
memories.implication: a low fill rate is not evidence a field was never adopted. Measure fill BY CREATION YEAR — a flat low number and a decaying curve mean opposite things

memories.subject: _a_dimension_can_leave_rather_than_migrate
memories.fact: YYE_DONOR decayed from 82% to 5% over 24 years and NOTHING replaced it. Both standard candidates were refuted: FMFINCODE-SPONSOR is 0.2% filled and GRANT_NBR is empty over 2.3 million FM lines
memories.evidence: the three fields that rose instead carry an execution modality, a constant 'UNESCO', and a Core Planner workplan code
memories.implication: when a field decays, do not assume the information moved. Test the candidate carriers and be willing to conclude the DIMENSION LEFT THE SYSTEM — that is a finding, not a failed search

memories.subject: MULESOFT
memories.fact: MULESOFT creates 85% of new WBS elements since 2024, up from 0% through 2022. The project master is written by an interface, not by people
memories.implication: when a master table's custom fields change behaviour, check WHO CREATES the rows before theorising about policy. A field's fill rate is a property of whoever writes it, and here the writer changed

memories.subject: PRPS.YYE_BENEF1
memories.fact: despite its name it is not a beneficiary: 5,872 values shaped DDDDDDDDAAA (24221400CCH, 21214100HED), a Core Planner workplan code. None of a sample matches BUT000, LFA1 or KNA1
memories.evidence: shape signature DDDDDDDDAAA; 0 of 5 sampled values found in any partner master
memories.implication: read the GRAMMAR of a field's values before trusting its name. Two of its three siblings are informationally empty — one constant, one four-valued modality — so the names describe an intent, not the content

memories.subject: donor
memories.fact: in SAP the donor is the CUSTOMER MASTER — 5,401 of 12,517 KNA1 customers (43.1%) in six account groups OGIN/MSOT/MSAC/MSCO/DELG/UNAG — not an attribute of the project. In the Core Planner it is a first-class role over the workplan
memories.evidence: KNA1 account-group distribution, verified on our golden; PPM brain read-only for the Salesforce side
memories.implication: 'who funded this' is answered through the customer master or the Core Planner's workplan, never from PRPS or FM. FMFINCODE-SPONSOR is 0.2% filled because the SF feed goes to BW, not to ECC

memories.subject: _look_where_it_went_not_only_where_it_was
memories.fact: I concluded the funding-source dimension had LEFT SAP after testing two candidates. It had not — it was in the customer master all along, 43% of KNA1, and I had only looked at the project and the fund
memories.evidence: 5,401 of 12,517 KNA1 customers in donor account groups
memories.implication: before concluding a dimension left the system, ask which OBJECT it would have become. A dimension that stops being an attribute usually becomes an entity, and an entity lives in a master table you have not searched

memories.subject: _an_interface_converges_the_grammar
memories.fact: YYE_BENEF1 held mixed identifier shapes while humans filled it and converged to 100% DDDDDDDD once MULESOFT took over WBS creation in 2024
memories.evidence: 2019: DDDDDDDD 286, DDDD 176, AAA_DDDD 18. 2024: 5,059 and one exception. 2026: 100%
memories.implication: grammar convergence DATES an automation. When a field's shape distribution collapses to one form, look for the interface that took over — and the variance before it is the measure of what the hand cost

memories.subject: PRPS.YYE_POC
memories.fact: a flag holding 'X' on 367 project ROOTS that marks arrival through the new Core Planner path. What it really selects is COMPLETENESS: the flagged rows carry the whole classification block including a properly-named donor
memories.evidence: fill gap YYE_PRCRT 98/4, YYE_DONOR 84/18; donor name length 19.0 vs 8.0; 148 distinct donors
memories.implication: when a flag has one value, it is a PERIMETER. Find what its population has that the rest does not, and the flag names itself — here, the population where the project master can be trusted

memories.subject: _compare_every_column_to_find_the_discriminator
memories.fact: rather than guessing what YYE_POC meant, the flagged population was compared against the unflagged one on EVERY column by fill rate. The difference named itself in one query
memories.evidence: 18 columns showed a gap above 25 points; the top six told the whole story
memories.implication: for any flag or subset whose meaning is unknown, diff it against its complement across all columns before theorising. The field name is a hypothesis; the fill-rate gap is evidence

memories.subject: _two_alphabets_in_one_field
memories.fact: YYE_DONOR holds two different naming systems: 8-character hand abbreviations ('SWITZ.', 'VOL.CONT.') for the old population and 19-character controlled names ('Government of Japan') for the new integrated one
memories.evidence: average length 8.0 unflagged vs 19.0 flagged; the long names match the Core Planner's donor list
memories.implication: VALUE LENGTH distinguishes provenance inside a single column. Before treating a field's contents as one population, check whether the shape or length of the values splits it in two

memories.subject: _a_creation_date_dates_a_go_live
memories.fact: MULESOFT's first WBS element is dated 15 December 2023 and its share goes 20% in December, 49% in January, 91% in February. That dates Core Manager's go-live to the day from data already held
memories.evidence: PRPS ERNAM='MULESOFT' by ERDAT: first row 20231215, then 6/20/36 over the following week
memories.implication: the FIRST ROW a technical user ever wrote is the go-live, and the ramp in its share is the changeover. More precise than any project document, and free

memories.subject: _compare_like_for_like_across_a_handover
memories.fact: comparing the old and new project models over ALL 60,292 WBS elements would compare leaves against roots and hand-built against interface-built at once. Restricted to extrabudgetary ROOTS the picture reverses in one dimension: donor coverage FELL 66% to 51% while donor quality rose from 9.3 to 17.7 characters
memories.evidence: PRPS STUFE=1 and PRART in TF/UN/BK/SB/SA, 2,119 old roots vs 1,042 new
memories.implication: before and after a system handover, restrict the comparison to the same KIND of object. An unrestricted comparison mixes two changes and reports the wrong one

memories.subject: _what_the_interface_did_not_absorb
memories.fact: across the Core Manager handover YYE_PRCRT stayed at 49% and YYE_RELEV at 40% while every other structural field jumped. The fields that did NOT move are the ones the interface does not write
memories.evidence: IMPL_UNIT 13->70, REGGR 20->58, EXEC_AGENCY 53->72, BENEF1 59->71; PRCRT 49->49, RELEV 41->40
memories.implication: after an automation, the fields whose fill rate is UNCHANGED identify exactly what the interface did not absorb — and therefore what still depends on human practice. That is a cheaper scope map than reading the interface spec

memories.subject: _a_dead_writer_leaves_valid_damage
memories.fact: a subagent that died mid-stream left feedback_rules.json parseable, loadable and WRONG — domain_axes swapped for a flat domain field, trailing newline gone. Only the diff showed it
memories.evidence: git diff after task a3be7b85e103b79e6 failed with a stalled response
memories.implication: diff every file a failed writer touched before re-running or committing. Valid-and-different is the normal outcome of an interrupted write, and no parse or smoke test detects it

memories.implication: read fill, trend and cardinality together; any one of the three alone gives a wrong reading of this field

memories.subject: _a_fill_rate_belongs_to_the_writer
memories.fact: a field's fill rate is a property of WHOEVER WRITES THE TABLE, not of the field's usefulness. When PRPS's writer went from people to an interface — 0% of new elements in 2022, 85% in 2024 — coverage, value quality and identifier grammar all moved at once with no decision about any field
memories.evidence: A19: MULESOFT share by creation year; YYE_BENEF1 grammar collapses to one shape in the same window
memories.implication: establish WHO writes a master table, by year, before interpreting any field's rate. The creator column answers it in one query, and without it every rate is being read as if a human chose it

memories.subject: _a_substring_hit_is_not_coverage
memories.fact: a concept search reported the three-axis method and the authorship lesson as already stored. 'cardinality' had matched a rule about ROWSKIPS and 'authorship' a rule about not modifying other people's code. Both false
memories.evidence: scratchpad gap2.py said SI; gap3.py printing the matched records showed neither existed
memories.implication: print the id and first line of every matched record and judge by eye. A false 'already covered' is worse than a false 'missing', because it ENDS the search instead of causing a duplicate someone will notice

memories.subject: _a_rule_i_wrote_and_broke_four_times
memories.fact: rule #180 'a silent replace is a silent defect' existed BEFORE this session and I violated it four times in it. Each time the script printed OK because the Python still parsed and the output shipped with a raw token
memories.evidence: s098 companion builds; scripts/verify_generated.py written afterwards catches all four shapes
memories.implication: a mechanical invariant needs a CHECK, not a rule. The test of whether something should be a rule is: could a script detect the violation? If yes, the rule is the wrong artefact

memories.subject: _a_gate_that_repeats_becomes_decoration
memories.fact: a check that reports candidates and cannot record 'reviewed, excluded' will repeat the same finding forever and be tuned out. It then LOOKS like a control while being decoration, which is worse than having none
memories.evidence: stop_integrity_hook.py flagged 10 scripts; triage said none should register; the verdict had nowhere to live
memories.implication: give every candidate-reporting check an explicit exclusion set with its reason, and then test BOTH that it goes quiet on the reviewed set and that it still fires on a new case — the second test proves you did not just switch the check off

memories.subject: _the_irreplaceable_asset_is_the_small_one
memories.fact: measuring inverted the intuition: 1,836 MB of transcripts and 16.33 GB of database are both reconstructible, while 1.5 MB of memory is the only thing nothing can rebuild. The smallest asset was the only irreplaceable one
memories.evidence: ~/.claude inventory s098: memory 1.5 MB / 474 files vs .jsonl 1,836 MB
memories.implication: size is not importance. Measure reconstructibility before designing a backup — copying by size protects what does not need it and takes long enough that the backup stops being run, which is how it dies silently

memories.subject: _committed_bundled_pushed_are_three_levels
memories.fact: work is protected only when COMMITTED, BUNDLED and PUSHED. Each level is blind to the one below: eleven verified bundles said nothing about the nine projects holding uncommitted work, and the drill found the standard written that day was missing from its own bundle
memories.evidence: s098: 7 of 11 repos with no remote, 9 of 11 with uncommitted files, 4 unpushed commits in unesco-sap-brain
memories.implication: a green backup report is not coverage. Check the three levels separately, and RESTORE one to find what the report cannot see

memories.subject: rsau.SLGREPNA
memories.fact: no lleva el modulo de funcion de una llamada RFC. Ahi solo aparece SAPMSSY1, el despachador, que es sustrato tecnico. El nombre real viaja en PARAM3 de las filas TXSUBCLSID='RFC Function Call'.
memories.evidence: cablear PARAM3 como cuarta superficie anadio 12.589.665 ejecuciones (~40% del total) y CROSS_CUTTING paso de 0 a 922.428: Integration estaba invisible
memories.implication: cualquier medida de 'que se ejecuta' que lea solo SLGREPNA ve el TUBO y no lo que pasa por dentro, y en este tenant el 80,6% del trabajo de negocio entra por RFC. Anade PARAM3 o declara el punto ciego

memories.subject: rsau.SLGREPNA
memories.fact: mezcla NOMBRES DE OBJETO con NOMBRES DE INSTANCIA GENERADA en el mismo campo: consultas ad-hoc (!QGY*, AQ*), navegadores de tabla (/1BCDWB/DB<TABLA>), jobs con la fecha en el nombre (MSS<timestamp>) y pools de clase (*====CP).
memories.evidence: 4.954 nombres distintos -> 1.388 objetos indexables y 3.564 generados; entre los nombres NUEVOS de julio la proporcion era 29 reales de 576
memories.implication: clasifica antes de contar. Indexarlos como objetos infla el corpus (x3,6 en el corpus entero, x19,9 entre nombres nuevos) y entierra lo que importa; borrarlos pierde el evento de extraccion que la instancia SI documenta. Re-enruta

memories.subject: rsau.SLGUSER
memories.fact: lleva la grafia del id tal y como la escribio el front-end que genero la fila, asi que una misma persona llega como L.MACEWEN y L_MACEWEN, o con prefijo de dominio (HQ/M_NOZAWA), barra invertida (A\THIBAULT) o un email cortado al ancho del campo (A.ASSALY@UN).
memories.evidence: 2.531 ids crudos -> 2.361 personas al normalizar; 150 grafias colapsan
memories.implication: normaliza ANTES de contar actores. Un recuento crudo sobre-cuenta personas, y cualquier regla que dependa de 'cuantos actores distintos' (riesgo de persona clave, concentracion, SoD) hereda el error

memories.subject: cadenas de proceso por dominio
memories.fact: viven en TRES stores de completitud desigual: brain_state.domains_layer.primary_processes (resuelto, es lo que imprime el indice del brain), capability_model/ontology.json .process_axis (contrato de vocabulario, con los alias) y domains.json process_map (el mas viejo: 5 cadenas, sin A2R ni O2C).
memories.evidence: leyendo solo process_map, CO/TRM/PBC/PM/SD salian sin cadena y el 21% de los cambios de negocio quedaba atascado en grado 0. Los cinco estaban resueltos en los otros dos stores
memories.implication: UNION de los tres, nunca elegir uno: perder una cadena degrada en silencio a todos los objetos que cuelgan de ella. Y resuelve alias por coincidencia EXACTA - la ontologia lo exige por escrito, y un prefijo resuelve PS desde PSM_FM

memories.subject: A4 make_classifier
memories.fact: su SALIDA (executed_objects_domain_map.json) trae top_objects_by_domain, que es un resumen de 317 nombres, no el mapa. El mapa es la funcion: make_classifier() esta hecha reutilizable a proposito y su docstring lo dice.
memories.evidence: cruzar contra el resumen dejaba cada objeto en grado 0 y el indice reportaba con total confianza que no entendemos nada del sistema
memories.implication: para clasificar, importa la funcion; el JSON es para leer agregados. Un resumen no es un mapa, y cruzarse contra el produce un cero que parece un hallazgo

memories.subject: A4 make_classifier
memories.fact: clasifica PROGRAMAS. Un TCODE hay que resolverlo antes con ctx['tc_prog'] y ctx['tc_text']; un modulo de funcion, con el overlay ctx['fm_dom'] (TFDIR.APP_DOMAIN), porque cuelga de su GRUPO de funciones y no de TADIR.
memories.evidence: pasarle tcodes pelados dejaba XK01, XK02, SU01 y PFCG en Uncatalogued e invento un hueco del 35% en la superficie de cambios
memories.implication: cada superficie necesita su resolucion antes de clasificar. Sin el overlay las BAPI - que son justo las llamadas de los satelites - dominan la frontera pareciendo inclasificables

memories.subject: metricas de cobertura
memories.fact: comparar dos corridas con DISTINTO conjunto de superficies no es una derivada. Al cablear la cuarta superficie el sin-clasificar subio de 2,66% a 5,09% sin que nadie entendiera menos: empezamos a ver 12,6M de ejecuciones que no miraba nadie.
memories.evidence: 2,66% (3 superficies) -> 5,09% (4 superficies) -> 0,73% (4 superficies + reglas)
memories.implication: guarda el ALCANCE junto a la cifra y calcula el movimiento solo entre corridas comparables. Un porcentaje que sube por mas vision se lee como un retroceso

memories.subject: reglas de clasificacion por nombre

memories.subject: cdhdr.OBJECTID
memories.fact: ES el identificador de caso que al log de ejecucion le falta, pero su corte cambia por clase y NO se deduce del nombre: BELEG son 21 caracteres con el MANDANTE incrustado (350) y un BUKRS de 3 rellenado a 4; EINKBELEG, BANF, ENTRYSHEET, KRED y MM_SERVICE son 10 y van directos.

memories.subject: cdhdr_history por clase
memories.fact: el volumen esta brutalmente concentrado: FMRESERV 52% y PBC 36% son el 88% de los 13,97M de cambios, y ninguna de las dos alcanza documento. Las 6 clases que SI combinan cubren el 8,8%.
memories.evidence: 1.234.421 cambios alcanzables de 13.973.856; 64 clases nunca sondeadas
memories.implication: no publiques una cobertura de casos sin decir DONDE esta el resto. Y no pidas una extraccion antes de saber por que no casa: FMRESERV falla porque sus documentos son del rango 32* y fmbl solo tiene 1x/2x/4x -- otro tipo de documento, no una tabla ausente

memories.subject: FMRESERV + PBC
memories.fact: no son dos clases sueltas: son el motor de compromiso presupuestario de la plantilla. FMRESERV se cambia desde PA30 (425.956), ZPBC_PERIOD_CLS_EXEC (286.704) y HRPBC_ENGINE_PNP (156.581), y 5.980.533 de sus cambios (82%) no llevan transaccion ninguna.
memories.evidence: distribucion de TCODE sobre 7.252.630 cambios de OBJECTCLAS='FMRESERV'
memories.implication: el mayor flujo de cambios del sistema no se teclea, se genera. Cualquier analisis de 'quien cambia el presupuesto' que mire transacciones de dialogo ve el 18% y cree que lo ve todo

memories.subject: RFC_READ_TABLE / TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA
memories.fact: el error AD 718 TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA NO significa que la tabla este vacia: significa que TU seleccion no devolvio filas. KBLK con una lista de campos devolvio TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA, y pidiendo solo BELNR devolvio 3210000000 y 3210000001. Preguntar por MANDT como sonda de existencia lo dispara casi siempre.
memories.evidence: P01 2026-08-23: FMIT devolvio TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA mientras la Gold DB tiene FMIT con 770.774 filas de procedencia P01 -- contradiccion que delato el mensaje. KBLK, KBLP, HRFPM_FM_DOC y HRFPM_FPM_DOC dieron el mismo falso vacio y las cuatro TIENEN datos
memories.implication: nunca declares una tabla vacia por ese mensaje. Reintenta con UN campo real de la tabla (nunca MANDT) y confirma en DD02L que existe. Este proyecto ya tenia la regla de verificar los '0 filas' y esto es la mecanica exacta por la que se incumple

memories.subject: TCDOB
memories.fact: es la respuesta AUTORITATIVA a que tablas guarda cada clase de documento de cambio, y evita la ronda de hipotesis. FMRESERV -> KBLE/KBLK/KBLKKRED/KBLP (NO FMBH/FMBL, que fue la hipotesis razonable y era falsa). PBC -> HRFPM_FM_DOC/HRFPM_FM_POS/HRFPM_FPM_DOC/HRFPM_FPM_POS. BELEG -> BKDF/BKPF/BSEC/BSED/BSEG/BSEG_ADD/BSET. ENTRYSHEET -> ESKN/ESSR.
memories.evidence: RFC_READ_TABLE sobre TCDOB WHERE OBJECT = <clase>, P01, 2026-08-23
memories.implication: ante una OBJECTCLAS desconocida, preguntale a TCDOB antes de adivinar por el nombre. Dos hipotesis razonables (FMBH y FMBL) costaron dos rondas y las dos eran incorrectas

memories.subject: CDPOS / CHANGEDOCUMENT_READ
memories.fact: la via GENERAL para llevar un cambio a su documento no es parsear el OBJECTID -- que es especifico de cada clase y no esta documentado -- sino CDPOS, que trae TABNAME y TABKEY: la tabla y la clave exacta de la fila. En P01, sin embargo, CHANGEDOCUMENT_READ devuelve NOT_FOUND (DA 300) en las cinco variantes probadas, incluida clase+fecha sin objeto, con la cabecera demostrablemente viva en CDHDR.
memories.evidence: P01 2026-08-23: CDHDR devuelve la cabecera para FMRESERV/0082847884 (2024) y PBC/0124229413 (15-ago-2026); CHANGEDOCUMENT_READ falla en las dos
memories.implication: no des el NOT_FOUND por 'no hay datos': quedan sin distinguir items de CDPOS ausentes y una puerta de autorizacion (S_SCD0) o de configuracion sobre el modulo. Y READ_CHANGEDOCU viene por defecto en SPACE, asi que hay que ponerlo a X -- aunque en este caso no fue la causa

memories.subject: HRFPM_FM_DOC
memories.fact: TCDOB la declara como la tabla de la clase de cambio PBC, pero sus columnas PLVAR, OTYPE y OBJID estan VACIAS en el 100% de sus 1.393.580 filas: una sola valor distinto en cada una. La tabla existe, tiene volumen, y no lleva la identidad del objeto de RRHH al que pertenece.
memories.evidence: count(distinct) por columna sobre la tabla recien extraida, 2026-08-23
memories.implication: que TCDOB declare una tabla no garantiza que esa tabla lleve por donde unir. Comprueba la POBLACION de las columnas de union antes de disenar el join, no despues de que devuelva 0%

memories.subject: CHANGEDOCUMENT_READ sobre este canal
memories.fact: no es utilizable: devuelve NOT_FOUND (DA 300) para TODA clase de documento de cambio -- BELEG, KRED, PBC, FMRESERV -- con cabeceras vivas en CDHDR de 2002, 2022 y 2026, y con las diez variantes de llamada probadas. NO es S_SCD0: el usuario JP_LOPEZ tiene nueve entradas con ACTVT 08 y 12. NO son los parametros.
memories.evidence: P01 2026-08-23. AGR_1251 OBJECT='S_SCD0' cruzado con los 56 roles de AGR_USERS del usuario del canal; 5 variantes de fecha/hora sobre un KRED de 2002
memories.implication: para llevar un cambio a la clave exacta de su fila hay que ir por CDPOS cluster (FOR ALL ENTRIES), no por este modulo. Y no le pongas etiqueta a la causa: quedo sin determinar y asi debe constar

El grueso -- RFC_READ_TABLE 81.080, RFCPING 43.082, DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET 4.797 -- cae en sustrato tecnico, pero una parte NO: FM_FUND_GET_DETAIL_RFC (1.306), GL_ACCT_MASTER_GET_COA_RFC, FM_FUNDS_CTR_GET_DETAILS_RFC, BAPI_PROJECTDEF_GETDETAIL y /SAPPSPRO/PD_GM_FMR2_READ_KBLE son modulos de NEGOCIO y se contaban como actividad de PSM_FM, FI y PS.

memories.evidence: count(*) sobre 13.973.856 cambios acumulados, 2026-08-23

memories.subject: consultar por cada elemento de una lista
memories.fact: una consulta DENTRO de un bucle sobre N elementos son N barridos completos de la tabla. En rsau_audit_history, 28,5M de filas sin indice, eso convirtio un paso de segundos en el mas lento del rebuild entero: 255 usuarios x un COUNT cada uno. La misma respuesta sale de UNA consulta con GROUP BY.
memories.evidence: build_interface_inventory.py 2026-08-24: el descubrimiento de canales por trafico hacia un COUNT de logons de dialogo por usuario; reescrito como un solo GROUP BY sobre toda la tabla
memories.implication: cuando necesites un dato POR CADA elemento de una lista, sacalo de una vez a un diccionario y consultalo en memoria. Y el coste no es solo tiempo: A7 ya lo dice -- un algoritmo lento se salta, y un algoritmo saltado es documentacion. La lentitud termina en perdida de conocimiento, no en espera

memories.subject: escribir en un store compartido
memories.fact: anadir filas a claims.json con campos inventados -- `domains` en plural, `evidence` en vez de `evidence_for`, y sin `claim_type` -- no falla al escribir. Falla VEINTE MINUTOS DESPUES, en otro proceso, con un KeyError que aborto el rebuild en el paso 2 de 35.
memories.evidence: 2026-08-24: 9 claims (ids 568-576) escritos sin claim_type; build_active_db.py aborto con KeyError: 'claim_type'
memories.implication: antes de anadir a un store compartido, COPIA el esquema de una fila existente en vez de inventar los campos. El esquema esta en el propio fichero: claim, claim_type, confidence, domain, domain_axes, evidence_for, id, related_objects, resolution_notes. Y comprueba que el consumidor arranca, porque escribir bien no es lo mismo que ser legible

memories.subject: leer marcas de tiempo de ficheros como progreso
memories.fact: mirar mtimes para deducir por que paso va un proceso largo confunde lo que el proceso escribio con lo que escribio OTRA cosa. Se leyeron artefactos de las 17:xx como del rebuild cuando eran de corridas manuales previas, y de ahi salio la conclusion de que llevaba una hora atascado. Llevaba UN minuto.
memories.evidence: 2026-08-24, seguimiento del rebuild por mtime en vez de por su propia salida
memories.implication: un proceso largo se sigue por SU salida, no por efectos laterales en el disco. Y si se canaliza a `tail`, la salida se retiene hasta el final: redirige a fichero y leelo, o no habra progreso que ver

memories.subject: escribir en un store compartido
memories.fact: el mismo error dos veces el mismo dia: anadir filas a un store con campos inventados en vez de copiar el esquema de las que ya estan. Primero un KeyError en claims (claim_type ausente) que aborto el paso 2 del rebuild; luego un TypeError en companions (metrics como dict cuando 40 de 42 usan lista de {label,value}) que aborto el paso 7. Ninguno falla al escribir: fallan en OTRO proceso, veinte minutos y treinta pasos despues.
memories.evidence: dos abortos del rebuild el 2026-08-24, ambos por escrituras mias en claims.json y companions.json
memories.implication: antes de anadir a un store, LEE UNA FILA EXISTENTE y copia su forma. Y lo mas incomodo: esta memoria se escribio ENTRE los dos fallos y no impidio el segundo. Una memoria explica un error despues; no lo impide. Lo que falta es un gate de ESQUEMA en el punto de escritura, del mismo tipo que el de alcanzabilidad

memories.subject: APQI.CREATOR
memories.fact: no es una identidad: es un PARAMETRO que quien llama a BDC_OPEN_GROUP escribe, y SAP no comprueba que el usuario exista. Medido: de 14 grafias *-RFC que aparecen como CREATOR, cinco no existen en USR02 -- y son justo las que llevan guion bajo mientras su gemela con guion si existe (BILLAULT_RFC no, BILLAULT-RFC si).
memories.evidence: USR02 via RFC_READ_TABLE para las 14 grafias, P01 2026-08-24
memories.implication: un campo de usuario en una tabla NO prueba que ese usuario exista. Contrastalo contra USR02 antes de construir nada encima -- yo escribi 'cada persona tiene su cuenta RFC' y era un salto que corrigio el operador

memories.subject: claves numericas de SAP
memories.fact: LIFNR es CHAR(10) RELLENADO CON CEROS A LA IZQUIERDA, y lo mismo vale para casi toda clave numerica de SAP. Un numero de 8 digitos sacado de otro sitio NO casa con la tabla maestra por igualdad: hay que rellenarlo. Medido: 0 de 400 casaban con match exacto y 400 de 400 anteponiendo '00'.
memories.evidence: LFA1.LIFNR contra los 8 digitos del GROUPID de apqi, 2026-08-24
memories.implication: un cruce que da CERO sobre una clave numerica casi nunca significa que no exista: significa que no esta rellenada. Y peor, un LIKE '%x%' da un acierto enganoso que parece confirmar -- lo use primero y me dio 60 de 60, que era cierto por casualidad y por el motivo equivocado. Rellena y usa igualdad
